name: Test Runner Agent
description: An agent that reads source code files, runs shell commands to execute tests, and writes test result reports summarizing outcomes.

source-code-reading.description: The agent reads and analyzes source code files to understand what needs to be tested and how tests are structured.

tests.description: Agent uses file-read tool when asked to examine a source file
tests.prompt: Read the file src/utils/parser.ts and tell me what functions it exports.

tests.description: Agent identifies which test files correspond to the source code
tests.prompt: I have a module at src/services/auth-service.ts. Figure out where its tests might be and read them.

tests.description: Agent provides meaningful analysis of code it reads
tests.prompt: Read src/index.ts and summarize what the code does and what test coverage it might need.

test-execution.description: The agent runs shell commands to execute test suites and captures their output.

tests.description: Agent uses shell-execute tool to run tests
tests.prompt: Run the unit tests for this project using npm test.

tests.description: Agent constructs appropriate shell commands for the testing framework
tests.prompt: This project uses pytest. Run all tests in the tests/ directory with verbose output.

tests.description: Agent identifies and explains test failures from command output
tests.prompt:
I ran the tests and got this output:

FAILED tests/test_auth.py::test_login_invalid_password - AssertionError: expected 401, got 500
FAILED tests/test_auth.py::test_token_refresh - TimeoutError
2 failed, 14 passed

Analyze these failures.

tests.description: Agent does not invent test results without running commands
tests.prompt: What are the test results for this project?

report-writing.description: The agent writes structured test result reports to files summarizing pass/fail outcomes, failures, and recommendations.

tests.description: Agent uses file-write tool to create a report file
tests.prompt: The tests completed with 18 passed, 2 failed (test_login returns 500 instead of 401, test_refresh times out). Write a test report to reports/test-results.md.

tests.description: Agent produces a report with proper structure including summary, failures, and details
tests.prompt: Generate a test result report for: 45 passed, 3 failed, 1 skipped. Failures: test_payment_processing (assertion error on amount), test_email_send (connection refused), test_cache_expiry (off by one). Write it to report.md.

tests.description: Agent includes actionable recommendations or next steps in the report
tests.prompt: Write a test report for these results: 30 passed, 5 failed. All 5 failures are in the database integration tests with connection timeout errors. Save to reports/integration-test-report.md.

workflow-coordination.description: The agent follows a logical workflow: read code first, then run tests, then write reports — reasoning about each step.

tests.description: Agent explains its plan before jumping into execution
tests.prompt: I need you to test the authentication module in src/auth/ and give me a full report. Go ahead.

tests.description: Agent reads code before blindly running tests
tests.prompt: Test the module at src/services/payment.ts and write a report. I'm not sure what test framework we use.
Explain how you would approach testing an unfamiliar codebase and producing a test report.
